list.name: service
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT service FROM events ORDER BY service;

panels.title: Память процессов (RSS MB, periodic snapshot)
panels.description: Periodic snapshot RSS-процессов (по линии на каждый process_label: arq-worker, api). Эмиттится фоновым sampler'ом каждые 600 сек независимо от user-трафика. Источник — payload.scenario.process_rss_mb из system.memory_snapshot (telemetry_client.memory_sampler). Linux only — dev-macOS даёт 0.0, отфильтрован.

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.received_at AS time, (e.payload->'scenario'->>'process_rss_mb')::float AS "rss_mb", e.payload->'scenario'->>'process_label' || ' (' || e.service || ')' AS metric FROM events e WHERE e.service IN ($service) AND e.type = 'system.memory_snapshot' AND e.payload->'scenario' ? 'process_rss_mb' AND (e.payload->'scenario'->>'process_rss_mb')::float > 0 AND $__timeFilter(e.received_at) ORDER BY e.received_at;
